purpose: Outcome-blind source/provenance and matched-control preflight for the <=90-day 2x+ Move Factory. This artifact authorizes no forecast, trade, promotion, OOS opening, broker action, or Phase-3 causal-acceptance change.

upstream_contract.matching_rule_summary: Freeze same-time/same-venue/same-sector/same-regime nearest-neighbor pools from pre-outcome covariates before labels. Never refill a pool because a candidate later moved or failed to move. Censored/missing/delisted outcomes are never negative controls.
upstream_contract.ownership_boundary: Do not modify PR #433 event-builder ownership from this artifact.

required_for_use: stable asset identity that cannot silently follow a recycled ticker
availability timestamp or a conservative timestamp rule justified by the raw public event semantics
raw-file or response digest when persisted
explicit missingness rather than inferred/default values
no current-universe filter applied before historical outcomes are known
forbidden: using today's exchange symbol list as the historical universe
using today's sector/category tag as if it existed historically
backfilling historical circulating supply from a current supply value
treating a missing derivatives/on-chain field as zero
discarding delisted assets because the provider no longer lists them
using an already-observed 2x outcome to decide which controls or fields to fetch
treating an archive retrieval timestamp as proof that a derived value was available at the historical decision time
silently rewriting historical records after an upstream archive correction

documented_fields: spot trades with trade id, price, quantity, quote quantity, trade timestamp
spot klines with open/high/low/close, quote volume, trade count, close time
sources.availability_semantics: For reconstructed features, use only raw trades/events whose public event timestamps are <= cutoff; completed-bar aggregates may be used only after the bar close. The downloadable daily archive itself is published later (documented as next day), so archive publication is provenance for the later historical copy, not the historical feature availability timestamp.
sources.revision_policy: Pin every downloaded archive/checksum. Binance documents that archived files can later be corrected; a changed checksum creates a new source version and must not silently replace an old research artifact.
supports: venue trading age from first observed public trade when full archive coverage is proven
same-venue historical member/tradable evidence when actual trade presence and gaps are audited
does_not_support_safely_by_itself: stable underlying asset identity across ticker migrations

documented_fields: catalog-all market/exchange coverage with min_time and max_time
sources.availability_semantics: Catalog min/max timestamps are useful for survivorship and coverage audits but are not automatically exact historical publication timestamps for derived metrics. A derived series must expose a defensible event/database/status timestamp or be independently archived before the cutoff to qualify as PIT evidence.
supports: cross-provider historical market existence cross-check including markets no longer current
selected community asset/network metrics when catalog marks them community-enabled
selected funding/open-interest/liquidation history when community coverage exists
does_not_support_safely_by_itself: exact PIT availability for every derived candle/metric
sources.coverage_rule: Field is eligible only asset-by-asset after catalog verification; missing community coverage remains MISSING, never imputed.

documented_availability_notes: last completed UTC daily point available about 00:35 UTC
Basic-plan historical range documented as restricted to the past two years
supports: historical market_cap_usd for covered IDs and eligible plan/range
sources.hard_rule: Do not purchase a new plan for this factory. Use only if an already-authorized key/plan exists and the exact requested date range is covered.

sources.reason_blocked: The endpoint is marked premium in current documentation and the factory is instructed not to add paid provider spend for routine work.

supports: leverage and derivatives precursor studies after gap audit
sources.risk: Historical metrics have documented missing periods for some symbols. Every feature must carry coverage/gap state; missing observations cannot be converted to zero or excluded after outcomes are known.

price.rule: Use a frozen venue and stable asset identity. Decision price must be the exact last completed supported bar/trade price at the decision timestamp.

liquidity_usd.rule: Freeze a pre-outcome window such as trailing 30 calendar days and sum quote notional from raw trades/klines. Label it venue quote-volume liquidity, not depth/ADV across all venues.

market_cap_usd.rule: Require timestamped historical market cap from an audited provider. CoinGecko may be used only with already-authorized access/range; Coin Metrics community coverage must be verified asset-by-asset. Missing means ineligible under the current #433 contract.

float_supply.rule: No zero-cost broad historical free-float/circulating-supply source is currently proven for the full liquid universe. Community/on-chain coverage may qualify selected assets only after catalog/status-time audit. Do not infer from today's supply or fill with total/max supply.

listing_age_days.rule: Measure from first verified public trade/listing event on the frozen venue, not from current metadata. If archive history is incomplete, leave unavailable.

volatility_30d.rule: Freeze estimator and cadence before labels; derive from only completed pre-cutoff bars.

return_30d.rule: Derive from only completed pre-cutoff bars using a frozen exact definition.

sector.rule: Current categories are look-ahead-prone. Require a timestamped historical taxonomy or a predeclared mechanical classification based only on information already public at each decision time. Do not assign a convenient current category retrospectively.

regime.rule: Use an outcome-blind BTC/market regime function based solely on data <= decision time; freeze thresholds before labels.

tradable.rule: True only when the frozen pair has observed public trading at the decision time and passes frozen freshness/gap rules. No interpolation across suspensions.

member.rule: Build membership from historical venue archives/coverage, including markets that later delist. Current exchangeInfo/current provider lists cannot define historical membership.

stable_identity_blocker.problem: Exchange symbols can be renamed, redenominated, migrated, or recycled. The event lab requires asset_id to be stable across history.
stable_identity_blocker.rule: Ambiguous identity excludes that interval rather than guessing.

pool_freeze_order: freeze stable identities and source versions
build and hash candidate neighbor pools without outcome access
only then attach 2x labels and choose complete non-movers from pre-frozen pools
control_eligibility: same PIT sector only if sector source passes audit
passes identical liquidity/member/tradable/missing-data gates as the event asset
complete forward 90-day observation with no unresolved gap/delisting censorship
did not reach 2x within the frozen horizon
not the same underlying asset within the overlap exclusion window
forbidden_control_shortcuts: replace a censored delisted asset with a surviving asset
refill farther neighbors after learning closer neighbors became winners
drop controls because derivative/on-chain fields are missing after seeing outcomes
count reused controls as independent observations
matched_control_preflight.base_rate_rule: Estimate full-cohort base rate only when the eligible cohort has outcome-complete coverage under a predeclared censoring policy. Matched-pair rates are conditional comparisons, not population base rates.

precursor_field_policy.baseline_matching_fields: Only fields whose PIT source audit passes before label opening.
precursor_field_policy.rule: Optional fields may be studied as separate frozen hypotheses with explicit coverage masks. They cannot retroactively decide cohort membership or matched controls unless a new predeclared dataset version is created before its outcomes are opened.

required_before_any_new_forward_2x_candi: matched-control/base-rate evidence that is not outcome-selected
no evidence that target was already reached before formation

facts: Current main has zero immutable big_move_2x rows in the production prediction ledger at this cutoff.
PR #433 already owns the historical event/control builder and remains open/unmerged.
PR #506 separately owns the immutable forward formation/resolution contract and remains open/unmerged.
Binance documents public raw spot/futures archives with checksums and later archive corrections.
CoinGecko documents historical price/market-cap/volume and separate historical circulating-supply endpoints with explicit availability constraints.
Coin Metrics documents a no-key Community API plus historical market catalogs and selected market/asset metrics.
inferences: A no-new-spend historical price/liquidity backbone is feasible, but broad PIT float supply and historical sector classification remain the strongest blockers to running the current #433 contract over a large survivorship-safe universe.
The scientifically fastest path is a narrow cohort whose every asset passes supply/identity/sector coverage, not a broad cohort padded with inferred fields.
hypotheses: A narrow, coverage-complete cohort can produce a cleaner initial estimate of precursor lift than a nominally broad universe with hidden survivorship and metadata look-ahead.
Derivatives/leverage fields are likely useful conditional precursors but should enter only after the baseline event/control cohort is frozen and their own missingness policy is predeclared.

next_bounded_action.action: Build a stable-asset identity + coverage manifest for a narrow liquid crypto cohort, using historical venue archives and no outcome data. Select only assets for which PIT market cap, supply and historical sector semantics can be independently proven. If fewer than the predeclared minimum qualify, persist COVERAGE_BLOCKED instead of weakening fields.
do_not: open event labels before the cohort/source manifest is frozen
create a forward candidate merely to populate a dashboard
